column1: # target-audit capability signal history. One row per stable signal ID.
# Seeded 2026-09-22 from the local reports and the published update articles;
# disposition and issues fill in as later runs settle each signal.
# The issues column holds comma-separated GitHub issue numbers without a leading #.

# vendor-date is the date on the vendor entry that announced the capability. first-source is the kind of source row whose delta showed it first: docs, changelog, schema, or code. shipped-date is the date of the agnostic-ai release that supports it, empty until one does. Leave a value empty when it is not known; never guess one.

column9: note
Junie --acp has no persisted project artifact; .junie/config.json field table carries no acp key.
published
published; the portable agent effort field shipped from the 824 design.

antigravity changelog v2.17.0 (2026-09-22): "A Markdown agent can list hook files in its front matter with a hooks: entry." Changelog-only; /docs/subagents names no hooks key. Question: does a docs page give the key's shape? 2026-10-10: subagents page still documents neither hooks: nor rules:, so no docs page gives the shape. 2026-10-13: Copilot CLI documents a hooks map in custom agent frontmatter (Copilot CLI only); x-copilot.hooks syncs it into .github/agents/<name>.agent.md (verified, no live session). Antigravity still changelog-only.

Warp factory skills use skills/<name>/SKILL.md for shared procedures and agents/<agent>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md for one role. Existing outputs.warp.skills-dir: skills plus source directory scope emits both, including assets; factory import discovers 0 skills. This factory layout replaces the interactive layout for that sync; no factory definition or deployment generated. Only Warp freshly verified here; earlier Qoder/OpenHands skill-selection semantics are not inferred to match.
Factory documents a tools: read-only category (docs.factory.ai/harness/subagents); portable readonly now maps to it with mcpServers: [] unless servers are listed (#1164).
Claude attribution:false works through x-claude; stable 2.1.285 clears the 2.1.281 channel gate. Older clients still skip settings containing false.
Codex 0.160 adds opt-in Guardian history/handoff context; features are UnderDevelopment, false by default. Native project TOML overlay round-trips all controls.
augment Auggie CLI 0.35.0 (2026-08-13): "declarative configuration for daemon pools"; Cosmos daemons page lists a project-scope daemon-config.json with no stated path or availability tier.
published
Factory SKILL.md allowed-tools, enabled, user-invocable, license, compatibility, version, metadata reach the file through x-factory; reproduced, no code change needed.

Cursor failClosed since 2026-09-15; Claude Code 2.1.295 added onFailure: block for command and HTTP hooks (changelog only); the claude adapter writes it from failClosed since #1916. 2026-10-10: hooks page documents onFailure; it has no effect on Stop, SubagentStop, TaskCompleted, TeammateIdle and async hooks, and denies on PermissionRequest (#1975). 2026-10-23: Windsurf stable v3000.11.205 (October 22) documents fail_closed on a failing hook. Raw x-windsurf settings retain it, but native nesting and enforcement remain unresolved; establish the shape before filing a fix. Confidence: conflicting. 2026-10-24: Devin release v3000.11.205 still documents fail_closed, but current hooks overview removed the exception and says other nonzero exits do not block. Native field nesting/enforcement remain unconfirmed; keep watch/conflicting, no fix.
Reachable today through x-kilo.permission (goal, goal_report); reproduced end to end, no code change needed.
Kilo skill license, compatibility, metadata reach SKILL.md through x-kilo today; reproduced, no code change needed.

Published Claude/Crush signal. 2026-10-11: OpenCode V2 supports manual-only skill selection. Discovery found the portable flag was dropped; #2064/#2072 preserves it and native metadata through sync/import in v0.83.0. V1 enforcement is absent.

2026-10-23: Amp documents Bitbucket, GitLab and other HTTPS Git hosts for shared project snapshots. Account-managed Git Repository and Secrets & Env Vars settings cannot be provisioned by local install scripts or x-amp settings. Introduction date unknown; decide setup scope and seek an automation contract before implementation. No clone or credential operation tested. 2026-10-27: Amp Orb docs add account-stored Pre-clone and Pre-setup scripts, an experimental workspace Resume Script, and a Shallow Clone project setting. None live in the repository, so local install scripts and x-amp settings cannot provision them. Introduction dates unstated. https://ampcode.com/docs/orbs/customizing 2026-10-29: Amp macOS Satellites attach a Mac executor to an orb behind an experimental account setting; services already pass platforms: [darwin] through x-amp.terminals. Still watch, no new project file.

2026-10-23: Kiro CLI 2.33.0 (October 20) documents per-user workspace trust before interactive V3 loads project hooks, agents, MCP, steering, workflows or language servers. Project specs cannot grant trust. Explain the setup prerequisite and never generate trusted state; headless/IDE behavior and runtime enforcement unobserved.
published; the settings effort field shipped in v0.66.0 from the 1069 design (claude, copilot, codex, factory).
Factory project marketplaces cannot be deleted in the manager while settings declare them (0.232.0, 2026-10-02); x-factory preserves project declarations.

goose discovers committed recipes in ./.goose/recipes/ (goose-docs.ai storing-recipes); v1.52.0 hardens recipe params and consent. No kind or x-goose route writes that path. Question: does a second target document a committed, parameterized task file the command kind cannot carry? Read the recipe field list directly first.

OpenCode experimental.policies in the project opencode.json (experimental; global wins over project): x-opencode.experimental.policies syncs with statement order kept (verified 2026-10-13). 2026-10-14: OpenCode V2 migration page puts system config and macOS managed preferences above global and project settings. 2026-10-24: Current OpenCode policies docs explicitly limit enforcement to V2; V1 retains the config without enforcing it. Keep existing serialization proof version-qualified; no native policy operation tested.
Both legs shipped: Qoder rule activation metadata round-trips (#1032), and Antigravity rules carry trigger frontmatter (#1117).

Ellipsis documents committed .ellipsis/agents/<name>.yaml agents with one cron or react trigger; no route writes the folder. Amp 2026-10-19 Linear subscriptions select an Amp project and mode, run as their creator, and live in account settings rather than a committed file. Generic hooks are unsupported and x-amp settings do not install subscriptions. Decide separately whether account-managed project automation belongs in scope; no portable trigger schema proposed. 2026-10-27: Ellipsis triggers page lists cron and react triggers for pull_request, push, issue, check_run, check_suite, workflow_run, status, release, linear_issue, slack_channel and sentry, one trigger per agent, plus enabled: false to pause. Agents are .yaml or .yml files with ellipsis.kind: agent anywhere under .ellipsis/. https://www.ellipsis.dev/docs/agents/triggers.md

Trae documents project SessionStart tagged context, TRAE_PROJECT_DIR, Bash/PowerShell launchers, a 30-second default, and consent gates. Dedicated native Trae and Devin memory hooks are implemented; Devin uses DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR, an explicit POSIX launcher, a 10-second timeout, and supplied payload diagnostics. Auggie CLI uses an executable SessionStart script; Cline VS Code uses project-only TaskStart contextModification. Antigravity uses static always-on memory includes. Native recall remains required before shipping #2106; native Devin Windows execution is undocumented.
Factory permissionRules (ID-resolved, test-verified command rules) replaces the deprecated command lists; x-factory.permissionRules reaches it today.
Cursor Security Review has no documented repo rules file; vendor changelog announcement is 2026-09-23, first observed 2026-09-28.

Codex CLI 0.158.0 connects to MCP servers with pre-registered OAuth client secrets via codex mcp add --oauth-client-secret. 2026-10-14: mcp_servers.<id>.oauth.client_secret is now a documented config key; sync still does not write secrets.

Kiro .workflow.json/yaml/yml recipes have documented graph schema and account/trust gates; existing Agent metadata emits Markdown, not recipes. CLI 2.27.0 keeps direct invoke_sub_agent beside Workflows by default. Copilot dynamic workflows (public preview, 2026-10-01) are JavaScript in project extensions at .github/extensions/<name>/extension.mjs; no shared declarative format with Kiro.

Cursor reads .cursor/config/bugbot.yaml from the PR base branch (64 KB cap; autofix.mode can lower, not raise, dashboard Autofix), separate from BUGBOT.md; current settings/review kinds cannot emit or import service policy.
Claude 2.1.287 bareElicitationCapability:true restores MCP compatibility; import and sync preserve explicit values in v0.77.0.
Claude 2.1.287 alwaysLoad:false forces all server tools behind search; import and sync preserve explicit false in v0.77.0.

Claude 2.1.287 Mods run unsandboxed in-process; Skill assets bundle a skills-dir plugin with x-claude.enabledPlugins. October 10: withhold-result outcome documented. October 12: prompt.autocomplete is documented; its introduction date is unstated. Plugin module/config survive sync/import/sync/check; no live session tested. 2026-10-13: Cline CLI/SDK loads project .cline/plugins/; only a skills-dir override could represent it, which moves every skill, so no clean representation. 2026-10-14: Amp loads project .amp/plugins/ (TypeScript hooks and tools); a hook spec for amp is reported unsupported, so no clean representation. 2026-10-15: documented Mods rendering in VS Code requires extension 2.1.299+ and fetched feature flags; supported UI elements vary. Existing skill-assets plus enabledPlugins representation survives import/sync/check; no live rendering tested. 2026-10-16: Cline CLI 3.0.72 removes CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=in_process; worker is default, sandbox remains available, and SDK 0.0.94 reports missing bootstrap rather than silently falling back into the hub. No clean project plugin representation or native execution was demonstrated. 2026-10-20: stable Claude 2.1.304 adds decider: person to a Mod tool.check answer, limiting documented approval routes to a person or host callback. Plugin assets and enabledPlugins survive import/sync/check/lint; plugin installation, activation and approval enforcement were not exercised. 2026-10-23: Amp project plugins document removable image/attachment confirmation fields. Existing settings and hook specs do not create plugin modules; keep explicit .amp/plugins/ files as the route. Introduction date unstated; no plugin load or attachment UI tested. 2026-10-29: Claude Mods reference documents Button variant, role and children (2.1.295+) and settings.read on its own read (2.1.304+); Amp plugins add checkbox confirm fields and ctx.ui.perform open-pane and open-portal. No new project file; representation unchanged and not re-run.
Claude 2.1.286 commit instructions request project verify/simplify skills at session start, except docs/tests changes; existing Skill and includeGitInstructions settings emit.

Copilot CLI repository command hooks inherit enabled session sandbox grants; cwd/env do not widen access, admin hooks remain on host. Output schema unchanged. 2026-10-14: Copilot local sandbox GA 2026-10-07, off by default, user or enterprise setting only.
Factory project imageGenerationModel defaults are independent of coding models; x-factory emits them, org image allowlists remain authoritative.
Claude 2.1.288 modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow in any settings file; x-claude.modelSettings syncs verbatim to .claude/settings.json.

Antigravity .agents/rules.json inherits/entries pull rules from other repos; skills.json, agents.json, plugins.json are changelog-only with no documented path. One target; rules kind has no cross-repo inheritance. 2026-10-10: rules.json is now on the rules page; skills, agents and plugins manifests stay changelog-only; x-antigravity.inherits on a rule is ignored.

.kiro/workflows/<name>.workflow.{json,yaml,yml} project recipes remain opt-in via kiroAgent.workflows.enabled; docs describe bundled agents using Powers, wf-design using configured MCP servers, and plan confirmation; no portable recipe kind. 2026-10-23: CLI 2.33.1 (October 21) requires explicit workflow invocation after enablement. Recipes remain opt-in/account-gated, with plan approval; existing agent/command kinds cannot represent recipe graphs. Retain the separate design decision; no workflow launched. 2026-10-24: Docs add IDE 1.4.26 and CLI 2.34 controls, but captured changelog gives no matching release proof. Recipe asset-copy works only with a target-wide skill-directory change that displaces built-in handoff. Keep watch and separate design decision; no recipe executed.

Kiro https://kiro.dev/docs/steering.md documents #[[file:...]] across surfaces and line ranges/#[[folder:...]] in IDE and CLI V3. Existing rule bodies preserve both native tokens; sync/import/check/lint verified, no native include expansion.
CLI V3 exposes workspace prompts in .kiro/prompts/ as slash commands; commands sync there since #1838.
Kilo memory_model in kilo.jsonc picks the model for project memory saves; x-kilo settings passthrough already emits it.
.cursor/sandbox.json project sandbox policy (network allow/deny, extra read/write paths); no x-cursor route to it today.
Devin CLI permissions.allow Write(<path>/**) in .devin/config.json lets Windsurf save to the repo-mode personal memory folder without a prompt.
Junie project model profiles in .junie/models/<id>.json (baseUrl, apiKey as ${VAR}); no route writes them today.

Kiro CLI V3 documents tool categories, source selectors, and wildcards. Portable on: before-tool maps to PreToolUse with anchored built-in tool IDs or @<server>/* for one MCP server (#1980). Other portable events and decision: stdout remain unsupported. CLI V3 UserPromptSubmit cannot block and Stop exit 1 continues (#1974).
Trae opt-in .agents/skills discovery gives .trae/skills priority; import reads only the native folder. Existing skill specs/output override represent it; shared-folder import tracked in #1947.

Claude stable/latest/next are 2.1.304 (published 2026-10-19), clearing the 2.1.296 gate. Project agent autoCompactWindow accepts 100000 through 1000000; x-claude.autoCompactWindow preserves the integer through sync/import/sync/check/lint. No native compaction tested. 2026-10-29: Claude Code 2.1.312 makes a subagent autoCompactWindow lower the CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW window; it never raises it.

Qoder CLI 1.1.66 adds a built-in plugin marketplace behind a feature flag; enabledPlugins is documented in .qoder/settings.json. x-qoder.enabledPlugins syncs (verified with an invented plugin ID). 2026-10-13: still reproduces with x-qoder.enabledPlugins.

OpenCode V2 mcp.servers.<name>.codemode controls grouped versus direct tool exposure. Existing settings x-opencode preserves native envelope and purpose-specific timeouts in actual sync. Discovery found native import loss; #2063/#2070 fixes it in v0.83.0. Vendor feature announcement date unknown; active V2 package metadata is not its announcement. 2026-10-27: the claim that a restricted agent loses an allowed MCP tool was disproved for OpenCode 2.2.0 (release note: "Expose Code Mode MCP tools directly when the `execute` permission is denied."). With execute denied, 2.2.0 exposes allowed tools directly; our generated "*" deny keeps denied tools hidden. The loss holds on 2.0.x to 2.1.4 by source only. https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/permissions

Kiro CLI 2.29.0 learns repository-scoped records in trusted local V3 sessions; writes require read/write access. No documented committed/shared project setting or import/export format. Kiro IDE 1.4.0 (2026-10-19) ships it to every IDE user as a user-only setting (a workspace value has no effect), still with no project file. Watch for that contract. 2026-10-21: https://kiro.dev/docs/memory.md now documents IDE default Off and a local per-user store shared by IDE/CLI with separate app settings; CLI default remains unspecified. No project setting or sync feature added.

Trae v3.6.0 Agent-window projects mount multiple paths and organize tasks/search across them. No documented native mount/workspace config or import API. Watch for that contract before proposing implementation.

Current import/sync round trip preserves Crush v0.98.1 channel_enabled and channel_reply, including incoming-message opt-in, explicit false and direct/group reply routes; x-crush overrides are mapped and validated.

Qoder CLI memory page documents <project>/AGENTS.local.md as project-private instructions for the current machine. No spec kind or x-qoder key writes it; .agnostic-ai/local instructions merge into AGENTS.md. Not compared on other targets.

Antigravity /docs/hooks?tab=ide lists a sixth event, SessionStart, a plain handler list with the matcher ignored; sync dropped it. The product changelog does not mention it and the docs do not say if the IDE fires it, so the memory built-in and on: session-start stay unmapped. 2026-10-16: IDE docs explicitly name .agents/hooks.json and SessionStart injectSteps output. Native event emission already works (#2124); portable on: session-start remains unmapped. Native IDE recall and launcher/wait behavior remain required before changing built-in selectors.

Kiro IDE 1.3 and CLI 2.31 read project .kiro/settings/sandbox.json (GA for V3, off by default; a project file cannot open network access or disable a global policy). No route writes it: a settings spec with x-kiro is reported unsupported.

Claude Code idleCompaction (v2.1.290+, latest channel only on 2026-10-14) syncs through x-claude; PreCompact/PostCompact auto matcher now covers idle compaction, so the handoff pre-compact hook also runs then. 2026-10-29: settings-reference says idle compaction is on by default and documents CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS (values below 100000 are raised); both still pass through x-claude.
VS Code documents a per-server sandbox object in .vscode/mcp.json (file system and network grants) beside sandboxEnabled. Sync emits only sandboxEnabled and drops the object.

OpenCode V2 reads one ordered permissions array in opencode.json where the last match wins. Sync writes only the V1 permission map; x-opencode reaches the array. 2026-10-15: restricted agents replay only the legacy project permission map and can override native V2 project deny/ask rules; #2267 tracks preserving those rules. #2211 shipped V1 pattern ordering, not native V2 agent replay, so no shipped-date is assigned to that V2 gap. 2026-10-16: #2269 implements native V2 project-rule replay and ordered agent serialization for #2267; current code supports this, recorded under Unreleased. No shipped-date until a release includes it; no native permission operation was tested. 2026-10-20: native V2 replay and ordered agent serialization ship in v0.86.0.

Factory sandbox (off by default) takes filesystem allowRead and allowWrite lists in .factory/settings.json or settings.local.json. #2225 writes the handoff store to settings.local.json; x-factory.sandbox still reaches settings.json only. Whether the local allowWrite list joins or replaces the shared one is undocumented.

Ellipsis reviewers[].skills points a Codex reviewer at a committed skill folder. x-ellipsis.reviewer.skills passes through and the codex target writes the folder. Claude Code reviewers do not support skills.
Ellipsis reviewers[].claude_code.settings.path applies a committed Claude Code settings.json below the settings Ellipsis manages, with hooks disabled. x-ellipsis passes it through.
Devin CLI v3000.11.92 adds PreCompact and PostCompact command hooks with manual and auto matchers; the hooks pages still list eight events.
OpenCode V2 top-level policies accept tool.use and integration.use besides provider.use; x-opencode.policies passes through today.
Kilo v7.8.10 adds experimental.glob_include_ignored in kilo.jsonc; x-kilo reaches it today.

Codex plugins._default is in the released 0.163.0 schema; native project TOML overlay survives import/sync/check/lint. Explicit plugin settings override the default but cannot enable source-disabled installations. No native activation tested.

Factory project mcpServers.<server>.enabledTools inclusion lists round-trip through x-factory and native import after #2291. Nonempty, empty and overlapping enabled/disabled lists survive import and sync. Support remains under Unreleased; no native tool filtering was exercised. 2026-10-20: the allowlist round trip ships in v0.86.0. 2026-10-23: Antigravity enabledTools survives native import, sync, check and lint through x-antigravity. Documentation hides other tools when set; empty-list and overlap semantics remain unstated. Introduction date unknown; native filtering was not exercised. Factory history remains separate.
Junie documents interactive /new and /worktree task isolation; no persisted project setting or artifact to emit. The October 15 page date is not a feature announcement date.
OpenCode V2 mcp.servers.<name>.protocol accepts legacy, auto or 2026-07-28; x-opencode settings preserve it through sync/import/check/lint. No native negotiation tested.
OpenCode V2 experimental.portable_shell_scanner syncs through x-opencode.experimental. Experimental parser selection only; no permission-rule change or native scanner invocation tested.

OpenCode V2 documents external_directory allowed by default, unlike V1. An explicit x-opencode.permissions rule emits today; #2293 corrects the package comment only. No native external-file operation or permission enforcement tested.

Kilo CLI preview v7.8.13, bundled in stable JetBrains v7.1.11, reports that custom parent edit rules no longer constrain children. Native extensions preserve agent and project rules; delegation and session-level enforcement remain unverified. Goose stable v1.55.0 (2026-10-16) binds children to parent hooks, mode and approvals (#12802), a different policy from Kilo. Existing agent and plugin-hook output represents the project artifacts; native delegation enforcement was not tested. 2026-10-20: stable Kilo v7.8.15 release/source re-confirms that custom delegator edit denials differ from session edit denials in task children. Agent Manager creates separate top-level sessions. Current per-agent rules emit unchanged; no native delegation or session restriction operation tested. 2026-10-24: Vibe 3.0.2 fixes inherited hooks and custom subagent tools permission/allowlist/denylist and skill filters. Native x-vibe fields survive sync/import/check/lint. Vendor release behavior only; no native delegation enforcement tested. Vibe semantics remain distinct from Goose and Kilo.

Junie documents committed .github/workflows/code-review.yml using JetBrains/junie-github-action@v1, custom review prompts and use_single_comment. Review/settings specs and import do not represent the workflow lifecycle. Decide separately whether workflow generation belongs in scope; no action was run. Vendor announcement date unknown.

Kilo v7.8.15 experimental Integrated Browser adds remembered browser_open origin approvals behind kilo-code.new.experimental.browserAutomation. Project x-kilo.permission.browser_open preserves navigate:<origin> and navigate:* actions through sync/check/lint; destination checks remain separate. Integrated Browser differs from Playwright MCP. No native permission or navigation tested.

Kilo v7.8.15 Agent Manager task.agent selects an existing primary/all project profile; subagent-only, hidden and unknown profiles are rejected by released source. Current .kilo/agents output preserves mode: all, maxTurns to steps and native permissions through sync/check/lint. This selects visible top-level sessions, not task children; no native Agent Manager session tested.

Amp https://ampcode.com/docs/customize/mcp adds custom headers and encrypted write-only secret values to account-managed project remote MCP definitions (--project/--current-project). Local amp.mcpServers headers already emit; no existing file route manages remote resources or write-only credential updates. Decide whether remote project resource administration belongs in scope. No native remote mutation or credential handling tested.

Claude Code 2.1.305 https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md adds sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces for Linux Chromium/rootless podman; vendor warns this permits bypassing sandbox file protections. Project x-claude settings emit it; native import seeds a settings overlay, with zero specs imported. Latest/next include it, stable 2.1.304 does not. No native sandbox enforcement tested. 2026-10-22: settings-reference now says Scope: User or managed, and Claude Code ignores a true in a project .claude/settings.json; a project x-claude spec emits a key with no effect (#2393).

Gemini CLI v0.65.0 https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/releases/tag/v0.65.0 adds telemetry.otlpHeaders for exporter routing/authentication headers. Project x-gemini settings emit a synthetic X-Audit header. Import creates zero settings specs; sync retains the handwritten native field in place, so import conversion is unproved. No collector connection or credential used.

Amp https://ampcode.com/docs/customize/mcp documents project-manager remote tool Allow/Ask/Disable policies checked on each call; local amp.tools.disable does not apply. No local settings, MCP or x-amp route administers account-managed remote policies. Decide scope and obtain a documented automation contract before implementation; no native enforcement tested.

Ellipsis reviewers[].gemini runs a review with Gemini CLI (gemini-4-argon or gemini-3.8-flash); GEMINI_ and GOOGLE_ variable prefixes are reserved. Sync writes and imports a gemini reviewer and stops reserved variables (#2385).

Codex CLI 0.164.0 releases PreModelRequest/PostModelRequest as observation-only project hooks. Existing import/sync/check/lint preserve both, but validation rejects the names (#2410). Fix the event vocabulary; stdout is diagnostic, not control flow. Released source wiring checked; no native model request observed.

Windsurf stable v3000.11.205 documents stop/continue replies and PostToolUse updatedToolOutput. Existing command-hook stdout represents both without a new field; shell reply bytes were checked, native turn/result control was not. Document native replies.

Junie drops generic and x-junie timeout values (#2411); emit milliseconds with its documented 1000-3600000 bounds and 60000 default. Antigravity timeoutSeconds already round-trips through x-antigravity: positive seconds replace connection/call limits, negative disables both, zero keeps defaults. Introduction dates unknown; no native request timed. Fix Junie without copying units or bounds.
Amp Task subagents inherit the main model and effort; old createAgent role pins are ignored. Existing agent-as-skill output does not create plugin code.

Claude Code >= 2.1.304 documents released public-beta server-managed MCP tasks. Existing x-claude.env waiting controls survive sync/import/check/lint. Session-kind/provider/feature flags gate availability; no native task executed and no generic task schema proposed. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp

Devin Desktop 3.11.212 runs standard devcontainer.json lifecycle commands and workspace options. Environment specs are unsupported; x-windsurf settings do not write that standard file. Decide field ownership before a container-settings route. No container launched. https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/changelog

Vibe 3.0.2 adds max_subagents and max_concurrent_subagents, defaults 32/32. x-vibe settings preserve both through sync/import/check/lint. Existing native fields suffice; no portable schema proposed. https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-vibe/releases/tag/v3.0.2

Goose documents project .config/goose/settings.json disabledPlugins. A settings spec raises unsupported and writes no file. Decide a native-settings scope and establish released loading/evaluation before a drift or enforcement claim; documentation and representation checked, no native discovery tested. https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/blob/main/documentation/docs/guides/context-engineering/plugins.md

CodeBuddy settings docs describe autoReview (policy, extraPolicy) for auto mode, read from user and .codebuddy/settings.local.json but not shared project settings.json. Released @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code 2.176.0 has no autoReview reference. When a release ships it, reject it in project settings next to autoMode. https://www.codebuddy.ai/docs/cli/settings

Qwen v0.26.1 documents .agents/skills/ and skills.directories as skill roots. agnostic-ai emits .qwen/skills/, which still loads. Skill paths gating already passes through x-qwen. No user loss today. https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/releases/tag/v0.26.1

Claude documents a skillOverrides setting (any settings file) with name-only, user-invocable-only and off values to hide or collapse a skill without editing its SKILL.md. Claude only; introduction date unstated; no representation route tested beyond x-claude passthrough. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference

Claude documents worktree.symlinkDirectories, worktree.sparsePaths and worktree.baseRef (fresh or head) in settings, and a .worktreeinclude file at the project root for gitignored files. Claude only; introduction date unstated. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference

Claude documents committed .claude/workflows/*.js scripts that become /<name> commands, and enableWorkflows and disableWorkflows settings (off by default on the Pro plan). x-claude passes the settings keys; no spec kind carries a script body to the folder. Existed since at least 2.1.178. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-directory

Amp directory plugins can bundle a standard skill and its resources, but Amp does not scan the plugin skills/ directory, so the plugin must register each skill when it loads; single-file plugins cannot register skills. Amp only; introduction date unstated. https://ampcode.com/docs/customize/plugins

Cursor Agent SDK is generally available: an agent is a folder of code kept under bot/, tested with evals, and deployed to Cursor or your own infrastructure; needs agent-sdk login. No spec kind targets the folder. https://cursor.com/changelog/agent-sdk

Copilot CLI reference documents a plain-text .github/allowed_models.txt that restricts built-in models for a repository, with a required fallback: MODEL-ID line; BYOK models are not filtered. No release date on the page. https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-cli-reference/cli-config-dir-reference.md

Vibe 3.0.3: post_agent hooks accept match to run only after a given agent, or after the main agent with match = "main". Our hooks.go rejects any matcher on post_agent, so sync aborts. Source at tag v3.0.3 confirms match is a free optional string; docs lag. https://github.com/mistralai/mistral-vibe/releases/tag/v3.0.3

Vibe loads plugins from ~/.vibe/plugins/ and, in trusted folders, ./.vibe/plugins/; they bundle skills with MCP servers, hooks and subagents, but this version does not run plugin hooks. No release date on the page. https://docs.mistral.ai/vibe/code/cli/skills

Warp Agent CLI keeps its own MCP configuration, separate from the Warp app's, reads only its own global file (macOS ~/.warp_cli/.mcp.json), so the ~/.warp/.mcp.json we write never reaches it. The shipped CLI still detects the project .warp/.mcp.json (vendor source, PR #14500), though the docs say project files are not detected. https://docs.warp.dev/agents/cli/configuration.md

OpenCode v2.2.0 adds provider.<id>.models.<id>.settings.cache.ttl in project opencode.json. x-opencode on a settings spec writes it and sync --check is clean; import opencode drops it. No live OpenCode run. 2026-10-29: OpenCode 2.2.1 splits variant settings out of model settings; variant settings no longer accept cache, model-level settings.cache.ttl is unchanged.

.github/copilot/settings.json enabledPlugins and extraKnownMarketplaces are read by Copilot CLI and Copilot in the cloud. x-copilot writes both and sync --check is clean; import copilot drops them. No native plugin activation run.

Antigravity replaces ${PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${PLUGIN_DATA} in a workspace plugin's mcp_config.json under .agents/plugins/<name>/. outputs.antigravity.mcp-file plus $${PLUGIN_ROOT} escapes writes it; unescaped, sync leaves the server out with a note that does not mention plugins. Introduction date unstated.

Grok reads subagent persona overlays from .grok/personas/<name>.toml (project) and ~/.grok/personas (user). No spec kind or x-grok key emits them; an unknown x-grok key on an agent is dropped. Docs last updated 2026-07-21, so not new in this window.

Crush main docs/hooks/README.md lists 13 hook events (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, PermissionResult, SessionStart, SessionEnd, TurnStart, TurnEnd, StopFailure, Interrupt, PreCompact, PostCompact); v0.98.2 still documents only PreToolUse. Becomes an adapter gap when a tagged release ships them.

Junie documents a committed .junie/extensions.json mapping marketplace ids to extensions (skills, MCP servers, subagents, commands, guidelines, hooks). x-junie lands in .junie/config.json and outputs.junie.conf-file is ignored, so no route writes the file.
Kilo config schema adds timezone, experimental.schedules and experimental.image_generate with no docs page or release note. x-kilo writes all three to kilo.jsonc; import kilo does not read them back.

OpenCode v2.2.1 adds opt-in scheduled prompts through /schedule and experimental.schedules, with a top-level timezone. x-opencode writes both and sync --check is clean; import opencode drops them. Schedules themselves are runtime state.
OpenCode v2.2.1 adds experimental.image_generate (optionally .model) for an image_generate tool. x-opencode writes it; import drops it.
OpenCode V2 skills array in opencode.json adds local directories and HTTP catalogs (V1 uses skills.paths and skills.urls). x-opencode.skills writes it verbatim; import drops it.
TRAE v3.6.5 adds an enterprise-only hooks on_failure policy (block or skip). The hook configuration reference names no key or file yet.
Vibe v3.0.3 adds outside_workdir = "deny" (global or per tool), strict_config = true and vibe config schema. x-vibe writes both keys to .vibe/config.toml and lint is clean.
